fields.name: connection
fields.doc: JDBC connection

fields.name: url
fields.doc: JDBC URL — jdbc:<dialect>://... (the dialect's provider must be installed)

fields.name: user
fields.doc: DB user

fields.name: password_env
fields.doc: Name of the DB password: a hub environment variable, else an lm secret

fields.name: dialect
fields.doc: JDBC dialect (inferred from url scheme if absent)

fields.name: zone
fields.doc: Time zone the source writes its dates-and-times without a zone in, for example Europe/Paris (read as UTC if absent)

fields.name: password
fields.doc: Plain-text DB password (dev/test only — wins over password_env; prefer password_env)

fields.name: defaults
fields.doc: Per-table defaults

fields.name: mode
fields.doc: Ingest mode (here or in defaults)

fields.name: schema
fields.doc: Table schema (here or in defaults)

fields.name: watermark_column
fields.doc: The column a watermark read moves forward on

fields.name: pk_columns
fields.doc: Primary key columns (non-empty; here or in defaults)

fields.name: indexes
fields.doc: Secondary indexes on the target table: [{columns: [...], unique?: bool (default false)}]
recommendations: indexes is a list of { columns: [...], unique?: bool } objects — e.g. indexes: [{ columns: [email] }]

fields.name: columns
fields.doc: Columns of the index, in order

fields.name: unique
fields.doc: Unique index (default false)

fields.name: rename
fields.doc: Rename source columns before they become hub columns: {source: target}

refused.name: chunk_size
refused.message: chunk_size is not a knob — jdbc chunking is fixed at 500 rows per read; remove it
recommendations: The engine reads its chunk size from the connector type, never from the manifest

fields.name: source
fields.doc: Source tables

fields.name: tables
fields.doc: List of tables to ingest (at least one)
recommendations: Add a table: { name: 'invoices', mode: 'full', pk_columns: ['id'] }

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Table name — also names the hub table connector.t_<name>, unless target names it

fields.name: target
fields.doc: Names the hub table connector.t_<target> in place of the source table's name (#1199)

fields.name: mode
fields.doc: Ingest mode (here or in defaults)

fields.name: schema
fields.doc: Table schema (here or in defaults)

fields.name: watermark_column
fields.doc: The column a watermark read moves forward on

fields.name: pk_columns
fields.doc: Primary key columns (non-empty; here or in defaults)

fields.name: indexes
fields.doc: Secondary indexes on the target table: [{columns: [...], unique?: bool (default false)}]
recommendations: indexes is a list of { columns: [...], unique?: bool } objects — e.g. indexes: [{ columns: [email] }]

fields.name: columns
fields.doc: Columns of the index, in order

fields.name: unique
fields.doc: Unique index (default false)

fields.name: rename
fields.doc: Rename source columns before they become hub columns: {source: target}

refused.name: chunk_size
refused.message: chunk_size is not a knob — jdbc chunking is fixed at 500 rows per read; remove it
recommendations: The engine reads its chunk size from the connector type, never from the manifest

fields.name: schedule
fields.doc: Cron expression for recurring ingestion

fields.name: window
fields.doc: Fence scheduled runs to a UTC time window, HH:MM-HH:MM (a manual run bypasses it)

fields.name: mapping
fields.doc: Not accepted — refused by validation (rows land as the source holds them)
